title: Dative Case — Indirect Objects
explanation: The dative case (celownik) is used for the indirect object — the recipient of an action — and after certain verbs expressing emotion or attitude (pomagać — to help, dziękować — to thank, podobać się — to like/please, dawać — to give). Dative singular endings: masculine/neuter nouns change to -owi (kot → kotowi, okno → oknu); feminine nouns change -a to -e or -i (kobieta → kobiecie, mama → mamie). Personal pronouns: mnie (me), tobie/ci (you), jemu/mu (him), jej (her), nam (us), wam (you pl.), im (them).
explanation_fa: حالت دادی (celownik) مفرد: مذکر/خنثی اغلب -owi می‌گیرند (studentowi، psu)؛ مؤنث: -a → -e/-ie (kobiecie، Polsce). جمع: -om برای همه (studentom، kobietom). کاربرد: مفعول غیرمستقیم، podoba mi się، potrzeba mi.

examples.note: mama (f) → mamie in dative; indirect object

examples.english: I like this music. (lit. This music pleases me.)
examples.note: 'mi' = dative of 'ja'; podoba się takes dative

exercises.prompt: Which sentence correctly says 'I give dad a gift'? (tata → tacie in dative)
exercises.explanation: 'Tata' is masculine but follows a feminine-like declension: dative is 'tacie'. The verb 'dawać' (to give) requires the recipient in the dative case.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'Thank you!' (dziękować + dative of 'ty', informal = ci/tobie)
exercises.explanation: 'Dziękować' (to thank) takes the dative. The dative pronoun for 'ty' (you, informal) is 'ci' (short form) or 'tobie' (long form).

exercises.prompt: How do you say 'I like this film'? (podobać się + dative)
exercises.explanation: 'Podobać się' (to please/like) uses the dative: 'mi' is the short dative form of 'ja'. The subject is the thing being liked.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'I help my friend.' (przyjaciel → przyjacielowi in dative; pomagać = to help)
exercises.explanation: 'Pomagać' (to help) takes the dative. Masculine noun 'przyjaciel' → dative 'przyjacielowi'.

exercises.prompt: What is the dative form of 'kobieta' (woman)?
exercises.explanation: Feminine nouns ending in -ta/-da change to -cie/-dzie in the dative: kobieta → kobiecie.
